SEARCH
Package restaurant.ui

Class GameUI

java.lang.Object
restaurant.ui.GameUI
public class GameUI extends Object
Console user interface for the game It purely functions as an I/O interface for other objects in the game It also serves as a filter to clean up inputs It contains no game rules The staff classes and the game loop decide what is allowed and calls the display methods All dialogue is looked up by key from messages.properties through the Messages class. The queue, tables, orders and statistics are update automatically Logic holding classes share the same instances of these objects so the methods don't get overloaded with arguments
